Town of Greece Adopt-a-Trail Program
There are more than 45 linear miles of recreational trails in the Town of Greece, most of which are
maintained by the town. These trails contribute to the community’s quality of life by providing access
to and through the town’s extensive system of parks, open space, and recreational facilities. The
purpose of the Town of Greece Adopt-a-Trail Program is provide an opportunity for local businesses and
organizations to be recognized in the community for contributing to the maintenance of these important
assets.
How to adopt a trail
Organizations wishing to adopt a trail must submit an application which will be reviewed by the town.
Adopting organizations will enter into an Adopt-a-Trail Agreement which outlines the nature of volunteer
maintenance activities and responsibilities of involved parties.
What is expected of the adopting organization?
 Annual or semi-annual trash pick up
 Trimming of branches/brush
 Spreading mulch
 Clearing obstacles
 Marking trails
 Reporting trail conditions (unsafe conditions / vandalism / mis-use)
What are the rules?
1. Your organization must provide proof of insurance with the Town of Greece named as additional
insured, and workers compensation if applicable
2. Trail maintenance activities must be scheduled and coordinated with the Town of Greece.
3. Gloves and long pants should be worn at all times by volunteers.
4. Use of power equipment or motor vehicles of any kind is prohibited.
5. Volunteers should not pick up needles, syringes, animal carcasses, large or heavy objects, or
any other item which could cause physical harm to themselves or other volunteers. Such items,
if encountered, should be reported to the Town of Greece for removal.
6. Volunteers should not engage in horseplay.
7. Children must be accompanied by adults. There should be no less than 1 adult present for
every 6 children in a volunteer group.
8. Volunteers must act responsibly. The Town of Greece reserves the right to terminate Adopt-a-
Trail agreements at its own discretion, or based on the conduct of individuals or organizations.
9. Trail maintenance performed under the Town of Greece Adopt-a-Trail Program may only be
performed by organizations which have entered into an Adopt-a-Trail Agreement.
